content.title: SILENT SIGNS OF A {{DEFICIENCY}}
facts: **Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands/feet, fatigue, memory problems, and low mood.
**Iron** – Pale skin, constant tiredness, shortness of breath, and brittle nails.
**Vitamin D** – Bone pain, muscle weakness, frequent illness, and low mood in winter months.
**Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, twitching, sleep issues, and irritability.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, hair loss, frequent colds, and reduced sense of taste.
**Potassium** – Muscle weakness, fatigue, heart palpitations, and constipation.
**Vitamin C** – Bleeding gums, easy bruising, slow healing, and joint pain.
